players-map_winner-journal.caption: Player-set controls · maps after picks. Broad nonglobal development evidence: 55,943 rows / 1,049 events. All 24 task/loss contrasts are plotted with pointwise 95% complete-event bootstrap intervals conditional on saved fits, omitting refitting uncertainty. Panels share scales across tasks within each loss. None has conservative Holm support in its declared family; a pointwise interval excluding zero is not an adjusted decision. Nonsignificance does not establish equivalence. DS = Deep Sets; ST = Set Transformer; Sel = frozen selector. BN uses general numeric histories; BNLC jointly adds linked histories and composition. Full-minus-general and set-versus-summary contrasts change more than one factor.

online-refresh-journal.caption: Online performance refresh versus the earlier residual and feedback-matched K20, broad nonglobal development population: 55,943 maps / 1,049 events and 25,186 series / 1,047 events. Points and intervals are percentage-point accuracy differences, with row and event weighting distinguished by both color and marker. All four comparisons are retained on a common scale. Pointwise 95% complete-event bootstrap intervals condition on saved fits, omit refitting uncertainty and are unadjusted. The six-hour scheduled availability proxy and global-update exclusion remain explicit. These are post-result exploratory accuracy comparisons, not adjusted probability-loss gains or prospective validation.

horizons-chronology-journal.caption: Schematic of the two target horizons and permitted chronological stages. Map forecasts assume the observed map and lineups/compositions are known before round one; series forecasts use earlier-appearance/usage proxies. Both use the declared scheduled-start lead, which does not verify historical publication timing. The core block-local source release proxy is two hours; online state uses six hours with strictly prior, equal-time frozen feedback and global exclusion. New unreviewed later-cohort rows are score-only. The five fitting/selection/calibration/evaluation stages describe the original protocol; retained later inference performs no new fit, threshold selection or calibration. This diagram is conceptual, not a measured timeline or proof of prospective operational availability.
